==Notes== 
*This spell has infinite range and affects all party members regardless of where they are in the instance.
*The caster is healed twice if they are enchanted.
*Combines well with [[Area of effect|AoE]] or party-wide enchantments, such as [[Aegis]], [[Dwayna's Sorrow]], and [[Orders build]] [[skill]]s (among various others).
